title: Best Family Deals in Gisborne & East Cape – October 2026
meta_desc: October 2026 savings for Gisborne & East Cape: campervans from $89/day, up to 40% off activities on Bookme, free beach fun and tips to keep a $120‑$200 budget.
intro: Gisborne and the East Cape offer sunrise surf, historic wharves and untouched Maori landscapes – all within a family‑friendly drive. With the right deals you can enjoy it on a $120‑$200 daily budget.

sections.heading: Current Booking Deals
sections.body:
Travel planners can lock in three core savings for October 2026. Bookme.co.nz is offering up to 40% off most activities across the North Island, including surf lessons, lighthouse tours and the Eastwoodhill Arboretum guide‑walk.

Campervan hire through Discover Cars starts at $89 per day for a family‑size 4‑berth vehicle – perfect for flexible road‑tripping along State Highway 2. Compare Jucy, Maui, Britz and Mighty in one search and add a $4.50 per day Cover‑More family travel insurance for peace of mind.

Accommodation on Booking.com features many holiday parks and motels with free cancellation, letting you secure a spot early and still adapt if plans change.
